FOUND and CONFIRMED (MONEY-1255). BSE publishes a per-scrip results XBRL index. 530127 -> 133 rows / 55 standalone links; 500325 -> 204 rows / 53 standalone + 53 consolidated. Rows carry stand_xbrl_link and conso_xbrl_link (site-relative /XBRLFILES/... paths served from www.bseindia.com), Filing_Date_Time, Revised_Date_Time, Status (New|Revised), Revision_Reason, and Fld_QuarterName (Quarter|Year). Basis is a COLUMN PAIR here where NSE files two separate records, and the period TYPE is stated rather than inferred from a date. SHAPE CAUTION: keyed by scrip code, with NO date range and NO paging, so there is no market-wide 'filings between X and Y' call — an ingest must iterate scrips. Found by reading BSE's own Angular bundle (main-*.js names Result_Arch_ng) rather than by guessing, then verified live.

Market-wide list of scrips that filed results TODAY (5 rows on 2026-08-26). Carries Scrip_cd, company_name, quarter_code, audited, DT_TM — and NO xbrl link, so a nightly ingest is two hops: today's filers, then one Result_Arch_ng per filer. It takes no date parameter, so a missed night cannot be re-asked for here; recovery is per-scrip via Result_Arch_ng, which returns a scrip's FULL history in one response.

Instances serve as text/xml and declare the two taxonomy families this repo ALREADY dispatches on — in-bse-fin (2018-03-31 / 2019-03-31 / 2020-03-31, a bseindia.com-HOSTED namespace) and in-capmkt (SEBI, 2025-01-31 / 2026-01-31). So BSE needs no new parser family; verified by parsing three captured instances in packages/core/__tests__/fixtures/xbrl/bse-*.xml. Five of the six directory x filename-prefix cells serve: FourOneUploadDocument/Main_Ind_As_*, FourOneUploadDocument/NonBanking_*, NBFCUploadDocument/NBFC_*, IFIndasUploadDocument/Integrated_Finance_Ind_As_*, IFOtherthanUploadDocument/IFOtherthan_*. See the next finding for the sixth.

findings.feed: BSE index DEFECT — integrated-era NBFC filings
findings.answer: BSE's index emits the WRONG DIRECTORY for exactly one cell. Integrated-era NBFC rows are indexed under /XBRLFILES/NBFCUploadDocument/Integrated_Finance_NBFC_* and every one of them 404s; the files are served from the sibling /XBRLFILES/IFNBFCUploadDocument/. The cell is narrow and the two dimensions had to be separated to see it: it is NOT the directory (NBFCUploadDocument/NBFC_* serves), NOT the era (IFIndas and IFOtherthan integrated files serve), NOT recency (Jan-2026 integrated files for 519421 and 532351 serve), and NOT the filer sector alone (legacy NBFC files serve). Verified 6/6 across three NBFCs (512437, 539773, 530127) and both in-capmkt versions. Two other sibling spellings 404, so IFNBFCUploadDocument is specific rather than a catch-all. The directory segment is CASE-INSENSITIVE (IIS). Implemented as bseInstanceUrlCandidates() in xbrl-filing-index.ts — a FALLBACK (indexed URL first, rewrite only on failure) so recoveries stay countable: if BSE fixes the index the count falls to zero; if BSE moves the sibling the FAILURE count rises instead. It is a WORKAROUND for someone else's bug, not a durable fact about their layout — re-test before deleting it.

findings.feed: BSE XBRL-details listing (DISPROVED route to results)
findings.answer: DISPROVED, with a control. Category 22 is literally named 'Financial Results' and returns ZERO rows at every date tried (a 2026 window, a 2024 window, market-wide and per-scrip), while category 7 returns 3,510 rows over the IDENTICAL range and date format. So the params are right and the empty is real: results XBRL is NOT reachable through this listing. Recorded rather than dropped because this is the first place anyone will look, and an empty 200 with no control beside it reads as 'wrong params' and gets re-derived forever. Note the endpoint states its own contract when dates are omitted ({"Error":[{"message":"From Date and To Date are mandatory."}]}), which is the ONE place the registry's '200-with-no-rows means the params are wrong' rule held here.

findings.feed: BSE announcement XBRL (NOT results) — a 200 that passes every shape check
findings.answer: Serves 200 text/xml with an <xbrli:xbrl root, reached from an announcement row whose category is literally 'Result' — and is NOT a results instance. The body is the in-bse-co ANNOUNCEMENT taxonomy: ScripCode, NameOfTheCompany, SubjectOfAnnouncement, AttachmentURL, CategoryOfAnnouncement. 1,645 bytes, zero financial facts. Anything validating on status + content-type + root element would archive these as results filings and project zeros. Also settles the three earlier 404s: XML_NAME (ANN_{scrip}_{GUID}) is NOT a filename — the announcement's attachment field is ATTACHMENTNAME (a bare GUID .pdf) and BSE builds that link as /xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/{ATTACHMENTNAME} (live) or /xml-data/corpfiling/CorpAttachment/{YYYY}/{M}/{ATTACHMENTNAME} (archived). The guessed DIRECTORY was right; the FIELD was wrong.
